leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a mapping of digits to their corresponding letters on a telephone keypad.
Initialize a recursive function to explore all possible letter combinations.
Manipulate string concatenation to build combinations during recursion.
Apply base case logic to terminate recursion and store completed combinations.
Integrate iterative loops within recursion to handle multiple letters per digit.
Render the final list of combinations for a given input string of digits.
Control the flow to handle edge cases, such as an empty input string.
